      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create a sample dataset\n",
        "data = {\n",
        "    \"Student\": [\"A\", \"B\", \"C\", \"D\", \"E\", \"F\", \"G\", \"H\"],\n",
        "    \"Study_Hours\": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8],\n",
        "    \"Scores\": [45, 50, 60, 65, 72, 80, 85, 95]\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(data)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Inspect the dataset\n",
        "print(\"FIRST FIVE ROWS\")\n",
        "print(df.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDATASET INFORMATION\")\n",
        "print(df.info())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Check for missing values\n",
        "print(\"\\nMISSING VALUES\")\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Calculate descriptive statistics\n",
        "print(\"\\nSUMMARY STATISTICS\")\n",
        "print(df[[\"Study_Hours\", \"Scores\"]].describe())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Calculate correlation\n",
        "correlation = df[\"Study_Hours\"].corr(df[\"Scores\"])\n",
        "print(\"\\nCORRELATION:\", round(correlation, 3))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 5. Visualize the relationship\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "plt.scatter(df[\"Study_Hours\"], df[\"Scores\"])\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Study Hours\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Scores\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Study Hours vs Student Scores\")\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
